instructions: LeanFM's book is durable agent context, not optional human documentation. Before requirements, design, or implementation work, read leanfm://project/book/main.pdf, leanfm://project/specification/SelfHosting.lean (LeanFM's own requirements), leanfm://project/specification/Requirements.lean (the registry), leanfm://project/specification/Requirements.proto, and leanfm://project/specification/Implementation.lean. Treat the book like a maintained portion of the system prompt. Work in order: observable requirements and their derived views, then the traceable implementation specification, then source
